site.title: Dumb Humanity
site.description: O conhecimento completo necessário para reconstruir a civilização do zero.

footer.missionText: Dumb Humanity preserves humanity's operational knowledge — the instructions for making everything again — in an offline-first, print-ready archive. It is not a website. It is a backup of civilization.
footer.openSource: Código aberto · Livre para copiar, imprimir e redistribuir

home.heroTagline: Backup operacional da humanidade · Offline · Pronto para imprimir
home.heroSubtitle: The complete knowledge required to rebuild civilization from the ground up — a structured, validated, reproducible path from a campfire to a space program.
home.tenStages: Ten stages. Each unlocks the next.
home.tenStagesDesc: Progress is strictly ordered — every stage contains the knowledge required to reach the one after it. You cannot skip rungs.
home.offlineFirstDesc: Cada artigo é HTML estático. Baixe o ZIP e toda a biblioteca funciona sem eletricidade, rede ou servidores.
home.printIsPermanentDesc: Redes elétricas falham. Telas morrem. Papel sobrevive a ambos.
home.validatedReproducibleDesc: Cada procedimento lista materiais, ferramentas, passos e a ciência por trás.
home.emergencyHubDesc: Kits de sobrevivência, primeiros socorros, sinais, purificação de água, abrigo, coleta, evacuação e comunicação.
home.scenariosHubDesc: Guias específicos por ambiente para ilha, deserto, ártico, selva, montanha, oceano e ruínas urbanas.
home.disastersHubDesc: Guias de desastres naturais e humanos — terremoto, tsunami, furacão, tornado, inundação, vulcão, nevasca, nuclear, industrial e pandemia.

about.title: Sobre Dumb Humanity
about.intro: This is an open-source, offline-first knowledge base for restarting human civilization — built in the spirit of the anime *Dr. Stone* and grounded in the real science of knowledge recovery.
about.whyExistsText: If civilization collapsed, the single most valuable resource would be **knowledge**: not gold, not machines, but the instructions for making things from scratch. Modern survivors know how to *use* things but not how to *make* them. This site is an attempt to close that gap with a practical, ordered technology tree.
about.sourceDrStone: Dr. Stone — the staged technology progression (stone → iron → electricity → radio), and the idea that knowledge is an adventure you can re-walk.
about.sourceInfoPreserver: The InfoPreserver Project (Lifeboat Foundation) — the "Rebuild Ladder" capability levels A0–A5 that organize this site.
about.sourceKnowledge: The Knowledge: How to Rebuild Our World from Scratch by Lewis Dartnell — the scientific method of civilization recovery.
about.sourceOSE: Open Source Ecology / Global Village Construction Set — open blueprints for the 50 machines that bootstrap a modern settlement.
about.sourceSurvival: Survival and bushcraft traditions — the low-tech fundamentals that keep people alive.
about.step1: Start at A0 — water, fire, shelter. The floor is not optional.
about.step2: Follow the survival priority — water, shelter, food, hygiene, then tools.
about.step3: Follow prerequisites — every guide lists what you need before it.
about.step4: Scavenge first — every guide lists what the ruins already provide.
about.step5: Teach and print — copy the guides, pass them on, and print the critical pages. Paper outlives grids.
about.principleDigital: Digital is temporary. Print is permanent.
about.principleRedundancy: Redundancy saves knowledge — three people must know every critical skill.
about.principleCompounds: Knowledge compounds — the ladder is faster at every step because the steps before it get easier.
about.contributeText: This is a work in progress, built incrementally. The content tree is open and structured to grow: every stage, every guide, every salvage list can be extended.
about.quote: "Humanity is science. That's all we are." — Senku Ishigami, Dr. Stone

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.tagline: Digital é temporário. Impressão é permanente.
downloads.subtitle: This archive is designed to be moved, copied, and printed. Power grids fail. Screens die. Paper and files you own do not.
downloads.fullArchiveDesc: The entire library as static files — every article, every guide, every diagram. Download once, open on any device with no network, no server, no electricity.
downloads.printableDesc: Per-guide print buttons, clean print CSS, and stage-based chapter packs. Laser toner is more waterproof than inkjet. Paper outlives screens.
downloads.sourceDesc: The markdown source of every article, versioned on GitHub and freely redistributable. Fork it, translate it, improve it.
downloads.rule1Strong: Three copies, two media, one far away.
downloads.rule1Text: Keep a digital copy, a printed copy, and a sealed backup stored separately.
downloads.rule2Text: Keep one master set dry and sealed; make working copies.
downloads.rule3Strong: Copy the ZIP to multiple devices
downloads.rule3Text: — a phone, a laptop, a USB drive, an old e-reader. Devices fail; copies survive.
downloads.rule4Text: The most durable format is a person who can explain the knowledge to the next generation.
downloads.packSurvivalDesc: Cenários de sobrevivência + artigos-chave (água, fogo, abrigo)
downloads.packEmergencyDesc: Kits, primeiros socorros, sinais + 5 novas páginas

techTree.title: Árvore Tecnológica
techTree.subtitle: Every node is a technology with a full guide. Arrows point from prerequisites to what they unlock. Nodes are colored by your progress — click a node to open its guide, and use the checkmark on each article to mark it mastered.
techTree.missingReqText: marks a guide whose prerequisite is not yet in the library.
techTree.rule1Desc: Each guide lists its prerequisites. A steam engine without iron is a rumor.
techTree.rule2Desc: Every guide lists what the ruins already provide.
techTree.rule3Desc: A technology only one person knows is one accident from being lost.
techTree.rule4Desc: Paper survives. Grids don't. See the
techTree.resetConfirm: Redefinir todo o progresso de domínio neste dispositivo?
techTree.hoverHint: Cada tecnologia depende das anteriores. Passe o cursor sobre um nó para ver o que ele precisa e o que desbloqueia.

ladder.title: A Escada de Reconstrução
ladder.subtitle: Inspired by the InfoPreserver project's capability ladder and Dr. Stone's staged tech progression. Each level answers one question. You cannot skip rungs — but every rung mastered makes the next one faster.
ladder.noteUnresolved: Note: {titles} reference technologies outside this tree.

print.subtitle: Redes elétricas falham. Telas morrem. Papel é permanente.
print.starterKitDesc: Tudo em A0 — água, fogo, abrigo, primeiros socorros.
print.starterKitTip: Print each guide page via your browser's print dialog. Use the "Print this guide" button on each page.

print.tip1Text: acid-free bond paper lasts decades; ordinary copier paper lasts years.
print.tip2Text: laser printer toner is far more waterproof than inkjet.
print.tip3Text: for the pages you'll use outdoors — water, fire, first aid.

emergency.title: Emergency Reference
emergency.description: Survival kits, first aid, and signaling techniques for when civilization fails. Print this section — you may not have a screen.
emergency.kitsDescription: Essential gear checklists for every environment. Build these before you need them.
emergency.firstAidDescription: Critical medical knowledge when help is days or weeks away.
emergency.signalsDescription: How to get found when you need help most. Three of anything is a distress signal.
emergency.universalSignalDesc: Three fires, three whistle blasts, three mirror flashes, three rock piles — three of anything repeated means you need help.
emergency.ruleOfThreesDesc: You can survive 3 hours without shelter, 3 days without water, 3 weeks without food.
emergency.waterPurificationDescription: Métodos para tornar qualquer fonte de água segura para beber. Água é a prioridade nº1.
emergency.shelterDescription: Tipos de abrigo para cada ambiente. Hipotermia mata mais rápido que desidratação.
emergency.foodForagingDescription: Plantas comestíveis e fontes naturais de alimento em cada ambiente.
emergency.foodForagingTagline: COMA O QUE A TERRA DÁ
emergency.evacuationDescription: Quando sair, onde ir e o que levar. Rapidez salva vidas.
emergency.communicationDescription: Como comunicar quando a rede cai. De rádios ham a códigos de assobio.

scenarios.title: Survival Scenes
scenarios.description: Environment-specific survival guides. What to do when you're alone, far from help, and the clock is ticking.
scenarios.rule1Desc: Sit, Think, Observe, Plan. Panic kills more people than the emergency itself.
scenarios.rule2Desc: Make yourself findable before doing anything else. Rescue is always the fastest way to safety.
scenarios.rule3Desc: 3 hours without shelter, 3 days without water, 3 weeks without food. Prioritize accordingly.
